summary: This directory manages the end-to-end lifecycle of file-level code analysis, providing the structural definitions, operational execution logic, prompt retrieval, and verification infrastructure required for source code summarization pipelines.
responsibilities: Define schema for file concepts and symbol metadata
Execute logic for generating file summaries
Validate and test data transformation and rendering outputs
relationships: The pipeline executor processes file inputs by utilizing defined metadata structures to generate summaries.
Prompt templates are retrieved to guide the generation and formatting logic within the pipeline.
Rendering and transformation layers verify that processed data correctly maps to required output formats.
designDecisions: Strict separation between data structure definitions and execution logic
Externalized prompt storage for configuration management
Isolated testing environments for validation of transformation and rendering logic
